name: papertime
description: Write any body of material as a dated reading note: answer first, a provenance block, every claim marked established, inferred, recalled or speculation, every number with its scale and a baseline, no em dashes, a 2,000-word ceiling, and a closing section that says what remains and what needs the operator's decision. Content agnostic, with a research special case. Ships the format, the voice rules, a template, a worked example, a mechanical checker and a page builder that turns the note into a designed HTML page. Skill invokes as papertime:papertime (or /papertime when the skill directory is vendored into a repository).
